details.description:
Update the SAST rule extension for the requested SAST rule extension ID

#### Required permissions

- `group.rule_extension.edit`

details.summary: Update a SAST rule extension by SAST rule extension ID

oneOf.description: A string containing the link’s URL.

href.description: A string containing the link’s URL.

meta.description: Free-form object that may contain non-standard information.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the SAST rule extension was created

created_by.description: User ID of the user who created the SAST rule extension

published_at.description: Timestamp when the SAST rule extension was published

published_by.description: User ID of the user who published the SAST rule extension

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the SAST rule extension was last updated

updated_by.description: User ID of the user who last updated the SAST rule extension

SastRuleExtensionRuleKeys.description: Array of rule keys that the SAST rule extension applies to.

SastRuleExtensionId.description: Unique identifier for a SAST rule extension

RuleExtensionDescription.description: The description for a rule extension to provide extra details on why it is safe to assume issues for this rule have been sanitized

RuleExtensionRequestType.description: The type identifier for the "rule_extensions" resource.

RuleExtensionStatus.description: The status for a rule extension. Rule extensions in draft do not apply to any analysis test until published

SastRuleExtensionConfigurationType.description: The type of the SAST rule extension configuration determines the Snyk SAST analysis behavior against the input fully qualified name.

SastRuleExtensionFullyQualifiedName.description: The fully qualified name of a function that performs sanitization in your codebase. Should Snyk SAST analysis detect this function being used, issues for the given rule will not be raised.

SastRuleExtensionKind.description: The kind of SAST rule extension.

UpdateSastRuleExtensionConfiguration.description: Configuration for update request. All fields are optional to support partial updates.
